gcp-6.1.title: Cloud SQL requires SSL for all connections
gcp-6.1.recommendation: Enable 'Require SSL' (requireSsl) on all Cloud SQL instances to encrypt connections in transit.

gcp-6.2.title: Cloud SQL instances lack public IPs
gcp-6.2.recommendation: Remove public IP addresses from Cloud SQL instances and use private IP or Cloud SQL Proxy instead.

gcp-6.3.title: Cloud SQL automated backups enabled
gcp-6.3.recommendation: Enable automated backups on all Cloud SQL instances.

gcp-6.4.title: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL log_error_verbosity DEFAULT or stricter
gcp-6.4.recommendation: Set the log_error_verbosity database flag to DEFAULT or TERSE on PostgreSQL instances.

gcp-6.5.title: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL log_connections flag on
gcp-6.5.recommendation: Set the log_connections database flag to 'on' on all PostgreSQL instances.

gcp-6.6.title: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL log_disconnections flag on
gcp-6.6.recommendation: Set the log_disconnections database flag to 'on' on all PostgreSQL instances.

gcp-6.7.title: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL log_min_duration_statement set to -1
gcp-6.7.recommendation: Set the log_min_duration_statement database flag to '-1' to disable logging of statement durations (prevents sensitive data leakage).
